description: View usage analytics for connected MCP servers — call counts, latency, error rates, and recent activity.

action.description: Action: stats (default — summary), recent (recent calls), slow (slow calls), reset (clear all data)

limit.description: Limit number of results for 'recent' and 'slow' actions (default: 20)

slug.description: Filter stats to a specific server slug. Omit for global stats.

threshold.description: Latency threshold in ms for 'slow' action (default: 5000)

name: mcp_usage
